text_block_list.text:
“—Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival! It's a major event welcoming 
fans into Tracen Academy, but this year—”

text_block_list.name: Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
Mommy... Do you think we'll be able to see 
Oguri-chan up close today?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! There are a lot of people, 
but you'll definitely get to see 
Oguri-chan!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
Man, there really are a lot of people 
here. Are they all here for Oguri? She's 
insanely popular.

At this year's Grand Appreciation 
Festival, fans who came for Oguri Cap were 
overflowing everywhere...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere of the Thanksgiving 
Festival is truly amazing. Though I 
suppose that's only to be expected with 
Oguri-san around...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing how excited Oguri-san's fans 
were to meet her made me think for a 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering... how I should face and 
interact with the fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Until now, to etch the "present" me into 
history, I've focused entirely on running 
races at full power and beating my rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Through repeated battles with beloved, 
formidable foes, my own brilliance 
increases, and as a result, that becomes 
my certain, shining trail of light—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—In other words, could it not be said that 
'I failed to consider the fans'?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Of course, at every Winning Live, I 
conveyed my wholehearted gratitude to 
everyone who watched my run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"However, that is merely what is expected 
of an Umamusume who lives to race. 
Shouldn't I have done more for the 
fans...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—...were the kind of thoughts running 
through my head.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...In the event I'm entering today, it 
turns out Oguri-san will actually be 
participating alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I have no fear of facing her in a race. 
However—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to facing the fans and 
entertaining them together... that's a 
slightly different story."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If you ask me whether I have zero doubts 
about the mindset I should approach this 
with, I must admit I have a few concerns.
choice_data_list: Why not approach it like you would a race?

Maybe you should approach it like you 
would a race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

—In the first place, Mejiro Ardan's fans 
have come here today because they are 
captivated by her brilliance—by the way 
she gives her all in every single race.

If she stays true to herself and gives her 
all at the Fan Thanksgiving Festival, she 
will naturally become the Mejiro Ardan her 
fans desire.
choice_data_list:
If you give it your absolute all, I'm sure 
the fans will love it.

If you give it your all, I'm sure the fans 
will be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Is that really how it is...?
choice_data_list: Let's go all out and win those fans over!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Your choice of words, Trainer, is 
always so amusing... and encouraging.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting~! The next matchup 
in the "Ogiri Race" is—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Here are Oguri Cap-chan and Mejiro 
Ardan-chan!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Once again, our contestants will answer a 
few prompts, and the victory will be 
decided by our viewing fans based on whose 
answer was funnier~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hosting the event will continue to be me, 
Super Creek, and Tama-chan, also known as 
Tamamo Cross-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Who on earth came up with this matchup?! 
It's a total pileup of airheads guaranteed 
to cause a massive disaster! Are you 
tryin' to work me to death?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's true, both Oguri-chan and Ardan-chan 
are just sooo sweet and adorable, aren't 
they~? They're so soothing to be around~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Take a look in the mirror before ya speak! 
You're one of the airheads too, Creek!

text_block_list.name: Audience Laughter
text_block_list.text: (WHOOSH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Tama really is amazing. No matter the 
situation, she always entertains 
everyone—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Ogiri. I've never done it before, but 
it's a word game that relies on quick 
thinking...! In a way, it's just like 
racing...!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then, here is our first topic! 
'Tama-chan rushed out of the dorm in a 
hurry this morning. Why did she do 
that~?'”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Why am I the topic?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (So fast—)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oguri-chan is fast! Here you go~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to eat the cafeteria's limited 
morning special, the extra-large Eggs 
Benedict, so I left the dorm first thing 
in the morning!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That was you yesterday!!

text_block_list.name: Audience Laughter
text_block_list.text: (WHOOSH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I can't lose...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Here you go, Ardan-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Tamamo-san is reliable and dependable, 
the roommate Oguri-san leans on. Which 
means—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since Oguri-san overslept, I went to the 
cafeteria to grab breakfast for her!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What am I, Oguri's lackey or her mom?!

text_block_list.name: Audience Laughter
text_block_list.text: (WHOOSH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are super pumped~! This is 
shaping up to be a heated battle~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I have no intention of backing down.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is bad. Those two are seriously 
plannin' to roll with this vibe. I'm 
seriously gonna die of overwork...――

Even after that, the back-and-forth battle 
(?) between Mejiro Ardan and Oguri Cap 
raged on—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And now, it's time to announce the voting 
results~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-I did so many retorts that my voice 
is...—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: The voting results are—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
By a hair's breadth, Oguri-chan takes the 
victory~!
(Clap clap clap clap clap clap clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...All right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Ardan's Male Fan
text_block_list.text: —Mejiro Ardan!!

text_block_list.name: Ardan's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
"That was so close, but it was crazy 
exciting--! You gave it everything you 
had--!"

text_block_list.name: Ardan's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
It had a totally different vibe from when 
you're racing, and it was super cute!! 
Please do it again sometime!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Thank goodness... The fans seemed to 
really enjoy it...!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad it looks like the fans on both 
sides had fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes— Truly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's compete again in front of our fans 
someday. Whether it's an ogiri comedy 
contest... or a race!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A handshake between the two who fought so 
valiantly~! How beautiful~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Give me a break from playing straight man 
to those two for a while...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
By a hair's breadth, Ardan-chan takes the 
victory~!
(Clap clap clap clap clap clap clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Ardan's Male Fan
text_block_list.text: —Mejiro Ardan!!

text_block_list.name: Ardan's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
That was super hilarious--! Please do 
something like this again--! I'll 
definitely come watch--!

text_block_list.name: Ardan's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
It had a totally different vibe from when 
you're racing, and it was super cute!!

text_block_list.name: Ardan's Fans
text_block_list.text: Ardan! Mejiro Ardan! Ardan-chan! Ardaaaan!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (So many of my fans... are here...!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad it looks like the fans on both 
sides had fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes— Truly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's compete again in front of our fans 
someday. Whether it's an ogiri comedy 
contest... or a race!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I won't lose next time...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A handshake between the two who fought so 
valiantly~! How beautiful~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Give me a break from playing straight man 
to those two for a while...

While Mejiro Ardan's event concluded to 
great fanfare, at the exact same time, 
elsewhere—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"—For so many people to gather for someone 
who's been away for so long... I'm just so 
happy...!"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
We hear you have an important announcement 
today, but what could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I, Sakura Chiyono O... will return to 
racing and aim for this year's Takarazuka 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (Ooooooohhh!!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm frantically making my final 
adjustments right now! Please look forward 
to my race and root for me, I'd be so 
happy!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O... I will make the 
flowers bloom on the turf once again!

Sakura Chiyono O's comeback announcement 
quickly went viral, and the public's 
attention on the Takarazuka Kinen 
skyrocketed...!
